test_chrono_system_clock: test the pybind11 chrono binding by calling test_chrono1 to get a C++ system clock as a Python datetime
test_chrono_system_clock_roundtrip: test the pybind11 chrono binding by roundtripping a Python datetime through test_chrono2 and back
test_chrono_duration_roundtrip: test the pybind11 chrono binding by roundtripping a Python timedelta through test_chrono3 and back
test_chrono_duration_subtraction: test the pybind11 chrono binding by computing a duration between two datetimes using test_chrono4
test_chrono_steady_clock: test the pybind11 chrono binding by calling test_chrono5 to get a C++ steady clock as a Python timedelta
